searchText: kells doesn’t have a light, so we walk through the squeaky side door and into the party on washington street. wander through the kitchen, and the hallway, the living room, down the stairs and find the party in the basement. the party is four people playing beer pong, a fifth, a freshman from chicago, cub said, pissing all over himself and the sump pump in the corner drunk dialing his dad. he’s not drunk he says. laughs, hangs up, says, “college.” one of them i recognize, a junior i think ceramics major, brynn banks, banging body, who is the younger sister of haleigh banks, who i think fulmer or was it jeff fucked last weekend and who is currently fucking brinson pettine, a lacrosse player, who is at least 82% gay, according to tad, who blew him in the bathroom during the bubba sparxx concert last semester. cub: “fuck you.” kells: “fuck you.” cub: “the freshman.” freshman: “who?” cub: “you. fuck you.” the freshman fumbles with his phone, asks why, cub says, “i don’t know,” and “fuck you” again, and “get the fuck out of here.” the freshman moves fast up the stairs, says, “no, fuck you,” falls, sounded like he slammed his shin on a stair, screams “fuck!” and flees the party.  he slams the side door and cub slides an upside-down solo cup towards him, turns it over and grabs a dime bag of some dirty ass shit, looks at kells and smiles. “never paid.” he says, “freshman.” “regos? really?” kells says, and “do you have a light?” “hello to you, too,” cub says, smiling, smirking really, now.  hamoody
